description: [Tracker] Add a job to the Tracker board (Quick Add) when it has no Tracker entry yet. Creating an entry records the job as applied: the new entry starts in the applied stage, dated appliedOn when given. Only call it after the user explicitly confirms they applied, and pass explicitUserConfirmed=true. Pass jobId, or companyName and roleTitle. Move the entry afterwards with trackly_update_tracker_stage, for example to interview. If the job, or the same company and role, is already on the board, nothing is written and the existing entry is returned with created=false. A repeated call never adds a second entry. Recording a Trackly job as applied with trackly_update_status creates this entry too, so this tool is mainly for applications that are not Trackly jobs (companyName and roleTitle).

appliedOn.description: Date the user applied, YYYY-MM-DD, read as a local date in America/Los_Angeles. Omit when unknown.

companyName.description: Company name, up to 200 characters. Required with roleTitle when there is no jobId; with a jobId it overrides the job's company name.

context.description: Briefly explain why this tool helps the current job-search goal. Never include resume text, profile answers, demographic or work-authorization answers, application notes, credentials, or secrets.

explicitUserConfirmed.description: Must be true: the user explicitly confirmed they applied to this job, because creating a Tracker entry records the job as applied.

jobId.description: Trackly job posting ID. The company, role, location and default link come from the Trackly job. Pass jobId, or companyName and roleTitle (or both, to override the job's names).

link.description: Posting or application URL, http(s), up to 2048 characters. Defaults to the Trackly job's URL when jobId is given.

roleTitle.description: Role title, up to 200 characters. Required with companyName when there is no jobId; with a jobId it overrides the job's title.

name: trackly_create_tracker_application
title: Tracker · Add a job
